prompts.sbom-pilot-icon-initial-prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished square original SBOM Pilot icon: a compact package/cube, compass-pointer motif and integrated component connections, expressing CycloneDX software inventory in Azure Pipelines. Crisp professional geometric illustration, high contrast, readable at 128x128, square PNG master >=1024, opaque background, centered mark with safe margin. No text, third-party logos, certification claims, mock UI or watermark. Initial output included a human pilot portrait; targeted edit below removes it.
prompts.sbom-pilot-icon-edit-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: SBOM Pilot software extension brand icon.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Remove the human pilot portrait completely. Replace that central portrait area with a clear abstract compass pointer behind the package cube. Keep the existing orange package cube, its three connected blue component nodes, the circular blue compass surround, the white opaque background, the crisp geometric illustration style and square layout. Simplify the overall mark to remain legible as a small software icon. No people, faces, hats, letters, additional objects, third-party logos or watermark. Preserve generous safe margins. Output a high-resolution square PNG.
prompts.sbom-pilot-hero-prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide hero illustration for SBOM Pilot Azure DevOps Marketplace overview.
Input image 1 is a visual identity reference, not an edit target. Create a polished wide 16:9 software-product illustration using that original compass, orange package cube and connected blue component forms. The product creates CycloneDX software bills of materials in Azure Pipelines. Keep the reference identity and a clean white/light-blue background, generous negative space, restrained detail, crisp professional digital illustration. Place the exact product title "SBOM Pilot" clearly in the composition with excellent typography. No other text. This is product artwork, not a screenshot: no fake application window, no made-up charts or controls, no third-party logos, no people, no security certification badges, no watermark. Output a high-resolution landscape PNG.
prompts.sbom-pilot-hero-edit-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is the edit target, the SBOM Pilot hero artwork. Change only the symbol on the document at the right: replace the purple spiral entirely with a plain blue inventory list of three small square bullets and three short horizontal rows. This must be a generic inventory document with no logo or symbol. Keep the title "SBOM Pilot", compass and package identity, connecting conveyor illustration, composition, colors, white background, high resolution and landscape aspect ratio unchanged. No third-party logos, no new text, no watermark.
